catalog.applies_to: AI Singapore as the creator of the SEA-LION model families it trains and announces, published under the aisingapore account.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where AI Singapore publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make AI Singapore a pilot creator.

github.com and huggingface.co are already-trusted generic hosts; the entries below bound link-following to AI Singapore's own aisingapore accounts on them, which is where its SEA-LION release information is published, rather than approving any new host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The SEA-LION repository under AI Singapore's own aisingapore GitHub account; authoritative for the SEA-LION version documentation and the release months it states. github.com is an already-trusted generic host; this bounds it to the aisingapore account.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30 (raw): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aisingapore/sealion/main/models/sea-lion-v3/sea-lion-v3.md returned HTTP 200 stating 'SEA-LION version 3, released in Dec 2024' and 'Llama-SEA-LION-v3-8B, based on Llama 3.1 8B, now provides a larger context length of 128K'. The model card records 'Developed by: Products Pillar, AI Singapore' and 'Funded by: National Research Foundation, Singapore'.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: AI Singapore's SEA-LION model cards are published under the aisingapore Hugging Face account. huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved.

AI Singapore's corporate site was not fetched or checked in this batch, so nothing about it could be verified. The SEA-LION release facts this batch relied on come from the aisingapore GitHub repository above. Approving aisingapore.org needs a fetch nobody performed here.

ambiguities.topic: SEA-LION v3 release date is stated to month precision
ambiguities.note: The SEA-LION v3 documentation states 'released in Dec 2024' with no day.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the release date as 2024-12 with month datePrecision. Do not synthesise a day the source does not give.

ambiguities.topic: Record the base Llama-SEA-LION-v3-8B, not the -IT variant
ambiguities.note: The instruction-tuned -IT variant's card states a later checkpoint that would not match the Dec 2024 date for the base model.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the base Llama-SEA-LION-v3-8B against Dec 2024. A date belonging to the base is not evidence about a later fine-tune.
